items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: And they had a bass horn player they called Eddie Jackson.

ctx.x: To see the different music. See, that fella used to play for Red. That fella didn't look like they was tired. Billy, they didn't look like they was tired. They didn't get tired. No, they didn't get tired. And they had a bass horn player they called Eddie Jackson. You know what I mean?
I heard of him. I never got to hear him, though.
